|"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" 出错 | 灰蓝色沮丧抖动 | 检查错误 |

- 🎬 **9 状态动画**：idle / running / waiting / revie"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"w / failed / waving / jumping / running-left / running-right

- ⚙️ **设置页**：Sett"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"ings → 宠物伙伴，切换宠物、缩放滑块（0.6x–2.5x）、开关
